alex: Heads up — invoice-preview is showing ~2x token counts for a subset of tenants after last night's canary deploy. :eyes:
alex: Correlated to enrichment service emitting extra route tags when fallback routing kicks in. Looks like duplicate tag variants are being counted as separate SKUs.
alex: Example event we saw in the preview:```json
{"tenant":"org-123","tokens":120,"route_tags":["realtime:v1","realtime:v1:canary"]}
```
priya: @alex which enricher commit rolled? I pushed a dedupe patch but intentionally left it disabled for canary traffic.
matt: Confirmed in metering logs — events with same fingerprint but different tag arrays are treated as distinct keys downstream, so they split token attribution.
jess: deploy-bot reports: canary-enricher v1.3.2 -> us-east-1 @ 2024-11-02T03:12Z (canary traffic 5%).
metering-bot: ingest_event_processed id=evt_q3f2 dup_tags_detected=true route_tags_count=2 token_sum=120 route_key_hash=0x9a7f
leo: The problem seems to be at the fanout: request goes to primary enricher then fallback enricher attaches a namespaced tag, we end up with both.
priya: Right — I disabled dedupe because I didn't want to change production enrichment semantics during canary. Maybe that was too conservative. :grimacing:
alex: Short-term options: 1) Pause canary, 2) Roll forward with dedupe enabled in enricher, 3) Add de-duping at metering ingress (cheap fix). Thoughts?
matt: Adding dedupe at metering ingress is lowest blast radius and quick. We can normalize route_tags to a set before fingerprinting.
leo: Agreed. We'll need to ensure this normalization is deterministic (sort then hash) so it doesn't change existing fingerprints for unaffected tenants.
jess: If we do ingress dedupe, console invoice-preview should be back to sane numbers within the hour. We should also add an alert to catch sudden changes in per-route token splits.
priya: I'll open a tiny PR to normalize tags in the ingress lambda. Will also roll dedupe config to enricher for the canary afterward so primary behavior matches.
metering-bot: ticket created MET-1427 "ingress: normalize/de-dupe route_tags before fingerprinting"
alex: Can we also add a console UX toggle to hide route-level tag variants in invoice-preview until we sort attribution? Minimizes customer confusion.
matt: Yep — add server-side masking for preview endpoint. Not changing persisted invoices.
priya: Deploy plan: patch ingress (hotfix) -> run canary for 1% -> validate invoice-preview diffs -> promote. ETA 45m for PR + 30m for canary.
jess: I'll mute alert noise and annotate the rollout in the console so support knows it's intentional.
leo: Also logging note: include pre/post dedupe tag_count in logs for 24h so we can audit impact.
alex: Thanks team — prioritize MET-1427 and the console mask. Postmortem notes: revisit "do not change dedupe behavior for canary" rule.
priya: on it. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout started: ingress-hotfix v0.2.1 -> canary 1% -> us-east-1
metering-bot: snapshot metrics queued MET-1427-snap-1 - will produce invoice-preview diff report when ready
leo: quick follow-up: add unit test asserting tag-set idempotency in both enricher and ingress modules.
